description: Svalboard key geometry as Keybard renders it. Units are key units (1u); Keybard draws 1u = 60px (default), 45px (medium), 30px (small).

sources.renderer: src/components/Keyboard.tsx:84-98 (keylayout first, SVALBOARD_LAYOUT fallback), :114-121 (unit size, legacy thumb offset)

notes: E/W are screen-compass directions, not inward/outward: E (col 1) is always +x, so it points toward the thumbs on the left hand and away from them on the right hand.
No key is rotated in any Keybard layout (KLE rotation_angle 0 everywhere); 'rotation' is always 0.
Keys are drawn edge to edge at w*unit x h*unit; the visible gap is the 1px border-kb-key-border on each key (Key.tsx:137-144).
variants.fragments_finger5 is checked to equal the keylayout stored in sval-default.svil exactly.
variants.fragments_finger6 is computed with the same composer for 6-key finger clusters (adds 2S at col 5); the thumbs move down 1u with it. Not checked against a live board: UNVERIFIED.

Which fragment a connected board uses comes from hardware detection or the user's selection (src/services/fragment.service.ts:282-330). sval-default.svil selects finger_5 for every finger (fragment_selections) although finger_6 is marked default in composition.

variants.legacy is only used when a board has no keylayout; the legacy renderer then adds THUMB_OFFSET_U = 0.3 to keys with y >= 6 (Keyboard.tsx:119-121, constants/keyboard-visuals.ts:19), recorded in renderedY.

svalbr (DATAHAND) finger keys equal fragments_finger5 exactly (all 40). Its thumbs sit 0.5u higher and 0.2-0.4u further out, carry no zones, and have no w (keybr's default width applies: UNVERIFIED, assumed 1u). It has no 2S keys. Against the legacy layout, svalbr's right-hand finger keys are +0.7u in x.
